competitors.name: Google Maps with Gemini (Ask Maps, Gemini in navigation, Lens in Maps)
competitors.whatItDoes: Conversational place Q&A (Ask Maps), hands-free Gemini while driving/walking/cycling: questions about route, places near you/destination, neighborhood ('What neighborhood am I in?'), landmark-based turn guidance, Lens 'what is this place and why is it popular?'.
competitors.discoveryModel: dynamic, user-initiated (pull); landmark cues are navigation-only, not storytelling
competitors.voiceAI: Gemini; hands-free voice; Gemini Live available in Android Auto (beta)

traction.signal: Ask Maps launched US + India on Android and iOS, works with CarPlay, Android Auto and Google-equipped vehicles
Gemini in navigation + landmark-based navigation announced
Gemini in walking/cycling navigation rolling out worldwide on iOS and Android wherever Gemini is available
Hands-on review: strong neighborhood/local trivia, weak at route edits

weaknessesVsUs: Pull-only: no evidence of proactive, continuous narration or a silence policy
Optimized for task completion (find, route, ETA) not storytelling
No persistent 'already discussed' journey memory as a product surface

competitors.name: Gemini in Android Auto (incl. Gemini Live)
competitors.whatItDoes: Replaces Google Assistant in Android Auto; answers about businesses along route via Google Maps; Gemini Live (beta) for open-ended conversation while driving incl. destination trivia.

traction.signal: Rolling out globally to Android Auto users, 45 languages

weaknessesVsUs: User must start the conversation; not a proactive guide
No trajectory-ahead significance ranking or silence budget

competitors.name: Apple Siri AI (iOS 27, Gemini-based) + Apple Maps + Visual Intelligence
competitors.whatItDoes: Redesigned conversational Siri with on-screen awareness (iOS 27, released Sept 2026); Camera 'Siri' mode identifies objects; Maps adds Local Lists / trending places. No confirmed proactive landmark narration found.

traction.signal: Siri AI unveiled WWDC 2026, ships with iOS 27 in fall 2026
iOS 27 released; Siri mode in Camera via Visual Intelligence; Maps Local Lists
iOS 27 Maps feature list contains no Siri landmark/route-narration feature

weaknessesVsUs: No evidence of proactive location storytelling
Also a gatekeeper: CarPlay voice-conversational category requires Apple entitlement

competitors.name: ChatGPT (voice mode, location sharing, CarPlay)
competitors.whatItDoes: Optional precise/approximate device location for local answers (Mar 2026); ChatGPT Voice in CarPlay (iOS 26.4+, audio-only answers, no wake word).

ChatGPT Voice in CarPlay; requires iOS 26.4; no text/imagery in responses; no wake word

General-purpose, hallucination risk on local facts vs our GroundingCheck
